summary.intent: Review the bug-fix branch fix/subdir-diff-and-pre-tags before accepting it, and check the codebase for other places with the same bug, as AGENTS.md requires.
summary.outcome: The branch passed review: both fixes are small and correct. The review also found five sibling sites that build rev:path specs without './' and may have the same subdirectory bug. A follow-up was sent to the branch's agent to verify and fix them.

repo: AGENTS.md requires grepping for structurally identical code when fixing a bug.
normalized_git_path returns a workspace-relative path with no './'. In a subdirectory workspace, a rev:path spec built from it likely resolves from the repo top instead of the workspace.
The fix for the subdirectory diff bug is to use rev:./dir specs; version_commit.rs already does this.
pre enter tag validation now uses semver::Prerelease::new instead of a hand-written grammar, so tags like 01 and beta.01 are rejected.

code.finding: git_file and batch_manifest_blobs_at build rev:path specs from normalized_git_path without './', so they are suspected of the same subdirectory bug.
prefetch_head_manifests, head_has_pending_changeset and manifest_blob_at build rev:path specs without './', so they are suspected of the same bug.

workflow: Review a branch's diff against origin/main with git diff origin/main...origin/<branch>, excluding Cargo.lock to cut noise.
After a bug fix, grep the base branch for sibling code with the same structure; here, git grep over format! patterns found the sibling sites.
Reproduce a suspected bug with the real binary in a subdirectory-workspace repo (workspace at r1/ws) before fixing, and fix only the sites that are actually wrong.

friction: The grep for rev:path format! patterns needed filtering (grep -v) and multiple passes to isolate the real sibling sites.
open_items: The branch's agent is verifying the five sibling rev:path sites with the real binary and will fix and test only the ones that are wrong, on the same branch.
The exit_kind work and the deletions are still running and unreported.
The note_once item stays dropped unless the user says otherwise.
